content.text: With a thrilling 2-1 victory in extra time against Germany, the Lionesses were crowned champions of UEFA Women's Euro 2022, securing their first major title before a record-setting crowd.

Helene Altgelt: 'The federation has realised this and now the Euros can be a great moment to kickstart that change and ensure women's football is going to be professional and more girls can live their dream of actually living by playing football and not having three side hustles or studying.'
